meta.title: Pasted Text Attachment
meta.description: Converts pastes longer than 5000 characters into a text file, with a link to restore the text to the composer.

notAttached: Couldn't attach pasted text. You can restore it to the text box.
restoreFailed: Couldn't insert the text. Try again when the composer is editable.
dropBlocked: Files can't be attached right now
